summary: On August 17, 2026, Chunghwa Telecom filed a Form 6-K reporting an announcement dated August 14, 2026, in which its subsidiaries, Light Era Development Co., Ltd. and Honghwa International Corporation, each announced the acquisition of right-of-use assets (leases) from Chunghwa Telecom. These are routine internal lease transactions between a parent and its subsidiaries, involving small lease amounts (e.g., NT$197,640 total for 9 ping) and standard lease terms (2026/11/01–2028/10/31). No special situation exists, as this is not an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic event. The filing is merely a periodic report of a foreign private issuer disclosing ordinary related-party lease agreements.
